activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1202, the publication year of Liber Abaci by Leonardo Pisano, as Fibonacci's representative mathematical milestone. The Republic of Pisa binding represents his Pisan civic identity and does not assert that every stage of composition occurred physically in Pisa.
